faqs: Which headphone stand should I choose?
Choose Arch or Ring Dock for a stand focused on headphones. Flow also holds a phone. Curve Caddy adds a place for pens, while Block Hub and Tower Trio organize headphones, a phone and pens together.

Check the approximate height on the product page and compare the photos with your headset. Headband shapes and earcup sizes vary. If your headphones are unusually large or you are unsure, contact us before ordering so we can check the fit.
Are the headphones and phone included?
Each order includes the physical stand described on its product page. Headphones, phones, pens and other photo props are not included.
Can I collect my stand in Edmonton?

Yes. Check the local pickup box in your cart before checkout. The current price stays the same, and your package includes a discount code for your next order after collection. The current reward is shown in your cart. We contact you to arrange a time and send the private pickup address.
The standard finish is similar to the main product photo, with slight shade variations. Contact Custom Build Studio before checkout to discuss another colour.
